hf.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
hf.abstract: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.
hf.titleZh: 通过视频阅读、书写、共享并与世界交互
hf.summaryZh: 以世界建模为统一视角梳理视频基础模型与视频世界模型：将观测视频视为潜在时序世界部分、有损且按时间排列的投影，围绕读（从视频推断世界属性）、写（按条件合成视频）、共享（用共通机制整合理解与生成）、交互（在动作与观测下预测并更新世界状态）四类操作组织文献，并区分序列时序连贯与底层世界状态一致。综述覆盖任务、表示、模型、数据集与基准，指出研究重心正从片段级识别与感知保真转向持久状态、可控演化、物理与因果有效性及基于交互和下游决策的评估，并总结开放挑战。
hf.reason: 视频世界模型综述偏生成，与LLM主线关联弱

hf.title: UserArena: Benchmarking Interactive User Simulation for Long-Horizon Shopping Agents
hf.abstract: Agentic recommendation pursues shopper goals through sequences of context-dependent decisions. Developing and evaluating such policies requires faithful recommendation world models that capture both the interactive shopping environment and users' behavioral responses over long interactions. Existing resources rarely provide long-horizon, fine-grained real-user trajectories or support trajectory-level evaluation and offline validation against production A/B results. We introduce UserArena, a real-world e-commerce interactive benchmark containing 64,729 session trajectories from 11,010 users, spanning 566,102 items and 13 action types. UserArena pairs these trajectories with an interactive environment and supports offline validation against outcomes from a controlled production A/B test, enabling five-level evaluation from output validity and local decisions to sequential behavior, personalization, and outcomes. To improve simulator fidelity over these long-horizon interactions, we further propose On-Policy Trajectory Distillation (OPTD), which uses trajectory-level intent to provide dense teacher targets on student-generated rollouts. Experiments show that OPTD achieves the strongest overall fidelity among the evaluated simulators under UserArena's evaluation protocol and most closely reproduces the production policy effect in offline simulation.
hf.titleZh: UserArena:面向长程购物智能体的交互式用户模拟基准
hf.summaryZh: 面向智能体推荐的长程策略评估缺乏忠实的用户行为模拟器与轨迹级验证手段。UserArena 汇集 11,010 名用户的 64,729 条会话轨迹，覆盖 566,102 个商品与 13 类动作，配套可交互环境，并可对照线上受控 A/B 实验结果做离线校验，支持从输出有效性、局部决策、序列行为、个性化到最终结果五个层级的评测。为提升长程交互下的模拟保真度，提出 On-Policy Trajectory Distillation(OPTD)，以轨迹级意图在学生模型自采样 rollout 上提供稠密教师信号。在该评测协议下，OPTD 取得最高整体保真度，且离线模拟最能复现线上策略效果。
hf.reason: 智能体用户模拟基准与 on-policy 蒸馏，切中环境合成与评测方向

hf.title: HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games
hf.abstract: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge this gap, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness. At the orchestration level, we equip the harness with structured memory for tracking progress and a VLM planner for selecting subtasks within the VLA's capabilities. To reliably determine subtask completion, we further introduce a policy-coupled task completion state detector that conditions on VLA policy context to signal candidate completion. At the control level, a single VLA executes all subtasks with vision-only perception and native keyboard-and-mouse actions. To mitigate interference between heterogeneous GUI and non-GUI interactions, we introduce regime-specific RMSNorm branches and separate mouse-movement token embeddings. We also train the VLA through world knowledge injection, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with environment feedback to improve reliability and recovery. HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance, scoring 85.0% on MineStudio Bench and a 37.4% average success rate on OpenHA, while also completing long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like human players.
hf.titleZh: HiSTEVE 1.0：利用人机接口 VLA Agent 玩转开放世界游戏
hf.summaryZh: 针对开放世界游戏中虚拟具身智能体既要长程自主又需原生界面控制的问题，提出分层 VLA 智能体 HiSTEVE：编排层用结构化记忆跟踪进度，并用 VLM 规划器在 VLA 能力范围内选择子任务；控制层用单个 VLA 仅凭视觉感知输出真实键盘鼠标动作，并通过策略耦合的任务完成状态检测器判断子任务是否完成。为缓解 GUI 与非 GUI 交互互相干扰，引入按交互类型区分的 RMSNorm 分支与独立的鼠标移动 token 嵌入，并以世界知识注入、模仿学习和环境反馈强化学习训练。在 MineStudio Bench 上取得 85.0% 的原子任务成绩，在 OpenHA 上平均成功率 37.4%，并能像人类玩家一样从零制作铁镐。
hf.reason: Minecraft 游戏智能体，属具身智能方向，不关注

hf.title: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
hf.abstract: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes. We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Rynn-VP and Rynn-GEU for long-horizon visual planning and anticipatory reasoning. Experiments show that RynnUnify achieves the highest average embodied understanding score among the evaluated unified multimodal models and improves the Rynn-VP overall score by 9.75 points over Cosmos 3 Nano. Its agentic extension improves the Rynn-GEU average by 6.0 points over direct reasoning, while the world-action extension achieves 51.5\% success on 20 selected composite RoboCasa365 tasks and 46.7\% average success across three real-robot tasks. Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.
hf.titleZh: RynnUnify:迈向统一的具身大脑
hf.summaryZh: 构建一个16B的统一具身模型，通过交错的视频—语言推理把具身理解与长程视觉规划结合起来，覆盖空间推理、物理预测与定位，并能想象各子任务推进时世界状态如何演化。在此基础上用强化学习做 agentic 扩展，让模型有选择地借助视频预测来推理未观测状态与交互后果，并进一步扩展出 world-action 版本以输出机器人控制。作者同时提出 Rynn-VP 与 Rynn-GEU 两个长程视觉规划与预见性推理评测，报告称其在所评测的统一多模态模型中具身理解均分最高，Rynn-VP 总分比 Cosmos 3 Nano 高 9.75 分，agentic 扩展使 Rynn-GEU 均分提升 6.0 分，world-action 扩展在 20 个 RoboCasa365 复合任务上成功率为 51.5%，三个真机任务平均 46.7%。
hf.reason: 具身智能与机器人控制，按画像归低分方向

hf.title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
hf.abstract: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. We present RSIHub, an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure. Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. Researchers can focus on evolution policy while evaluation stays outside the mutable surface and results remain tied to candidates and evaluation conditions. We instantiate AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA without modifying the framework core, keeping method-specific logic in recipes and operators. We evaluate them with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and τ^3 Banking under fixed model and evaluator configurations. The largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 percentage points, while method rankings vary across settings and optimization gains do not always transfer to held-out tasks. RSIHub provides a common protocol for comparing evolution policies, inspectable candidate histories, and reusable components for developing new methods.
hf.titleZh: RSIHub:一个用于智能体演化方法的可组合框架
hf.summaryZh: 智能体演化方法依赖执行反馈来改进提示词、技能、工具与编排，但各类实现往往重复搭建同一套实验机制。RSIHub 将方法拆成可复用的算子与声明式可变资源的 recipe，由框架统一提供执行、评估、恢复与血缘追踪，并保证评估不进入可变面、结果与候选及评估条件绑定。在 Terminal Bench 2 与 τ^3 Banking 上以 MiniSWE 和 Codex 实例化 AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve 与 GEPA，固定模型与评估器配置下整体 pass@1 最大提升 13.5 个百分点，但方法排序随设置变化，优化收益并不总能迁移到留出任务。该框架为比较演化策略、审视候选历史与开发新方法提供了公共协议与可复用组件。
hf.reason: Agent 演化与自进化框架，系统性强且直击 Agentic RL 方向

hf.title: Omni-Woodpecker: Hallucination Correction via Evidence-Prior Rebalancing for Omni LLMs
hf.abstract: Recent Omni LLMs (OLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in joint audio-visual reasoning, yet cross-modal hallucinations remain a major challenge. Existing mitigation methods mainly operate at the output level, overlooking the entanglement of grounding evidence and learned priors within fused representations. To address this issue, we propose Omni-Woodpecker (OWP), a training-free framework that shifts hallucination mitigation from output-level manipulation to conflict-conditioned representation rebalancing. Specifically, OWP first identifies cross-modal conflicts from complementary modality-specific views. It then employs orthogonal decomposition to separate grounding evidence from competing priors within the hidden states. Finally, OWP adaptively rebalances fused representations by suppressing misleading priors and restoring ignored evidence before decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and strong cross-architecture generalization of OWP. Using Qwen2.5-Omni-7B as the backbone, OWP improves performance by 12.9 and 8.6 points on CMM and AVHBench, respectively, while consistently achieving gains of 0.67-2.25 points across four general OLLM reasoning benchmarks. Furthermore, OWP generalizes effectively to VideoLLaMA2-AV, improving performance by 4.6 and 3.9 points on the same benchmarks. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZiiJianLiu/Omni-Woodpecker
hf.titleZh: Omni-Woodpecker:通过证据先验再平衡纠正 Omni LLM 的幻觉
hf.summaryZh: 针对 Omni LLM 跨模态幻觉，现有方法只在输出层干预，忽视融合表示中 grounding evidence 与学习先验的纠缠。OWP 是免训练框架:先从各模态互补视角识别跨模态冲突，再用正交分解把隐藏态中的证据与竞争先验分离，解码前自适应抑制误导性先验、恢复被忽略的证据。以 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 为骨干，CMM 提升 12.9 分、AVHBench 提升 8.6 分，四项通用推理基准稳定增益 0.67–2.25 分，迁移到 VideoLLaMA2-AV 仍分别提升 4.6 与 3.9 分。
hf.reason: 多模态理解侧幻觉纠正，免训练即插即用，方向相近但非核心

hf.title: Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization
hf.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories. Self-distillation offers denser token-level guidance by comparing an unassisted policy with a feedback-informed self-teacher, yet the teacher evolves with the student, creating unstable targets and motivating additional regularization. We introduce Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO), a single-policy framework that combines current privileged adaptation with function-space temporal consolidation. FSPO stores sparse historical next-token distributions as fixed temporal targets, providing temporal separation without maintaining a persistent teacher model. It further introduces privileged disagreement correction to explicitly suppress locally overvalued actions, reliability-adaptive grounding that strengthens reference supervision when self-generated evidence repeatedly fails, and quality and coverage-aware temporal memory that retains verified behaviors and improves privileged demonstrations. Across reasoning and tool-use benchmarks, FSPO achieves the highest average accuracy under a 5-hour training budget, improving over the strongest baseline by approximately 4% points on average while reducing peak memory from about 70 GB to 56 GB on Olmo3-7B-Instruct.
hf.titleZh: 面向策略优化的函数空间时序自蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: RLVR 只用稀疏的标量结果对整条回答轨迹进行监督，而现有自蒸馏因自教师随学生同步演化，目标不稳定且需额外正则。FSPO 用单一策略框架把当前特权自适应与函数空间时序固化结合：把稀疏的历史 next-token 分布存为固定时序目标，以获得时间上的分离，无需维护常驻教师模型；并引入特权分歧纠正抑制局部被高估的动作、可靠性自适应锚定在自生成证据反复失败时加强参考监督、质量与覆盖感知的时序记忆保留已验证行为。在推理与工具使用基准上，FSPO 在 5 小时训练预算下取得最高平均准确率，较最强基线平均提升约 4 个百分点，并将 Olmo3-7B-Instruct 的峰值显存从约 70GB 降至 56GB。
hf.reason: 自蒸馏与RLVR后训练改进，含显存效率收益

hf.title: Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
hf.abstract: We introduce TWIG (Tree-structured Weights with Inherited Gates), a representation in which every weight of a neural network is the end of a path of small discrete decisions: a sign, a shift by a power of two, a zero gate, an index into a shared table. Weights that belong together share the upper part of their paths, and each decision is inherited by every weight below it, so it is stored once and applied once. This simple change has three consequences. Any trained network can be written as a TWIG, and when the decisions are powers of two its weight layers become circuits made almost entirely of wires and adders, suited to chips whose weights are fixed at fabrication. Pruning, quantization, low-rank factorization, codebooks and weight sharing become edits of one object, so a single optimizer can choose among all of them for a whole network. And choosing the decisions is the ground-state problem of a higher-order Boltzmann machine whose interactions follow the paths of the tree, the problem class that annealers and quantum optimizers are built to solve. Today these questions are handled apart: each compression method brings its own format and solver, a circuit with fixed weights needs a dedicated constant multiplier for every weight, and discrete solvers reach only narrow subproblems such as rounding. Weight formats have long been moving toward shared decisions, through group scales, shared exponents, microexponents and sparse weights; TWIG takes this trend to its end, and every common format is a shallow TWIG at no extra cost. On five weight matrices of a large language model, a flat tree whose signed power-of-two terms are chosen per weight for circuit cost, with no group scales, needs 9--15\% fewer additions than GPTQ at equal layer error at 3- and 4-bit accuracy on typical matrices, and 20--55\% fewer on matrices with strong outliers.
hf.titleZh: 每个权重都是一条共享离散决策的路径
hf.summaryZh: 剪枝、量化、低秩分解、码本与权重共享目前各有自己的格式与求解器，固定权重电路还要为每个权重配一个专用常数乘法器。TWIG把每个权重写成树路径上的一串小离散决策（符号、2的幂次移位、零门控、共享表索引），上层决策被下层所有权重继承，因此只存一次、只用一次；这样一来，各类压缩都变成对同一个对象的编辑，单个优化器就能在全网范围内取舍，而选择这些决策等价于求解一个高阶玻尔兹曼机基态问题，其相互作用沿树路径分布。在大语言模型的五个权重矩阵上，不设分组尺度的扁平树在3比特、4比特精度下，与GPTQ达到同等层误差时少用9–15%加法，在离群值强的矩阵上少用20–55%。
hf.reason: 统一量化与权重格式，但偏电路与离散求解硬件

hf.title: Dual Exam: Controlled Evaluation of Multimodal Agents and World Models
hf.abstract: World Models (WMs) can support Multimodal Agents (MAs) through simulated experience, while Agent trajectories can inform World Model refinement. Evaluating this interaction requires separate evidence about action selection and state evolution. We introduce Dual Exam, which tests Agents under fixed environment response mechanisms and World Models under fixed action interventions across physical, digital, social, and scientific domains. The Agent track compares 10 configurations on 1,088 items in 15 reporting categories. The World Model track contains 400 cases across eight scenarios; 15 configurations have full coverage and one covers six scenarios. GPT 6 Astra leads the case-weighted Agent Index at 31.3, and GPT-Image-2 leads the full-coverage WM Overall at 21.7. These scores use different tasks and metrics and are not directly comparable. A 150-case pilot of one coupled pairing records zero task successes and motivates component-level diagnosis. Results reveal uneven task performance and failures to preserve task-relevant state. Their value for predicting coupled success or sustained reciprocal learning remains to be established.
hf.titleZh: Dual Exam:多模态 Agent 与世界模型的受控评测
hf.summaryZh: 多模态 Agent 与世界模型的相互促进缺少可分离的评测证据，现有基准往往把动作选择与环境状态演化混在一起考。Dual Exam 拆成两条赛道:固定环境响应机制考 Agent 的动作选择，固定动作干预考世界模型的状态预测，覆盖物理、数字、社交、科学四个域。Agent 赛道比较 10 种配置、1088 道题、15 个报告类别;世界模型赛道含 8 个场景、400 个案例，15 种配置实现全覆盖。GPT 6 Astra 以 31.3 居 Agent Index 首位，GPT-Image-2 以 21.7 居全覆盖 WM Overall 首位。150 例耦合配对试点任务成功率为零，说明需回到组件级诊断;其分数用于预测耦合成功率或持续互学仍待验证。
hf.reason: 多模态 Agent 与世界模型的受控评测基准，命中评测与方法学方向

hf.title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
hf.abstract: On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals. In this work, we reformulate on-policy self-distillation as a self-training framework, driven by self-generated question-answer pairs and privileged reasoning demonstrations. We push supervision to the limit: guided solely by coarse, high-level topic descriptions, the model synthesizes its own curriculum of queries and privileged reasoning traces without access to any human-curated prompts or answers. We find that self-distillation on fully synthetic privileged information enables a model to improve across multiple domains while retaining its capabilities on domains it is not self-trained on. We demonstrate the generality of this framework across text and multimodal domains, achieving consistent self-improvement on standard language benchmarks and Visual Question Answering. Our findings demonstrate that foundation models possess rich latent capabilities that can be amplified without external task supervision or curated problem distributions.
hf.titleZh: On-Policy 自训练：大语言模型中的无数据自我改进
hf.summaryZh: 现有on-policy自蒸馏依赖真实问答对、人工整理的题目集或其他监督信号。该工作将其重构为自训练框架：只给定粗粒度高层次主题描述，模型便自行合成训练课程——自生成问题与带特权信息的推理轨迹，再对这批全合成数据做自蒸馏，全程不使用任何人工提示或答案。在文本基准与视觉问答（VQA）上均取得一致的自我提升，且在未参与自训练的领域上能力得以保留，说明基座模型蕴含的潜在能力可在无外部任务监督、无人工题目分布的条件下被放大。
hf.reason: 无数据自蒸馏与自我改进，直接命中后训练方向

hf.title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
hf.abstract: A live esports broadcast needs a director who chooses which camera goes on air and a caster who talks over that choice, every second and without knowing what comes next. Streaming video language models have learned to commentate, but only over a broadcast that a human director has already produced. We study live broadcast production, in which a model receives the raw camera of every player and must both direct and commentate from the past alone. We present DirCast, a single streaming video language model that does both. Every second it scans all cameras at low resolution, decides with a hold-or-switch director whether and where to cut, and reads the chosen camera at high resolution before it speaks. Its context keeps what went on air and what was said and lets the other views expire, which bounds the cost of a stream of any length. We build a dataset of 27 professional Dota 2 matches with a camera for every hero, the human director's choices and the casters' commentary. DirCast directs better than rule-based and zero-shot directors including GPT-5, and its commentary wins 29.2 percent of comparisons against GPT-4o under the Proact-VL protocol, against 19.4 percent for the strongest of eleven streaming commentators that watch the human broadcast.
hf.titleZh: DirCast:用单一流式视频语言模型完成实时电竞导播与解说
hf.summaryZh: 直播电竞赛事需要每秒决定切换哪路画面并即时解说，现有流式视频语言模型只能对人工导播好的成品信号做解说。DirCast 让单个流式视频语言模型同时完成这两件事:每秒以低分辨率扫视全部选手视角，由 hold-or-switch 导播模块决定是否切换机位，再高分辨率读取选中画面后生成解说;上下文只保留已播画面与已说内容，其余视角过期，使任意长度流的开销有界。在含每位英雄独立机位的 27 场职业 Dota 2 比赛数据集上，DirCast 的导播优于规则法与包括 GPT-5 在内的零样本导播;解说在 Proact-VL 协议下对 GPT-4o 的胜率为 29.2%，而十一个观看成品信号的流式解说模型中最强者为 19.4%。
hf.reason: 流式多机位 VLM 系统设计有新意，但属电竞赛事垂直应用

hf.title: DiscoDemo: Discovering Efficient and Diverse Robot Demonstrations for Imitation Learning
hf.abstract: Behavior cloning for robotic manipulation is highly sensitive to the coverage of its training data, yet collecting diverse successful demonstrations remains costly. We study reinforcement learning (RL) not as a deployable controller, but as a data generator for downstream visuomotor imitation learning. Our key premise is that multiple successful solution modes cover a broader range of successful trajectories than repeatedly collecting a single narrow solution. We introduce DiscoDemo, which trains a privileged latent-conditioned RL generator with a parallel reverse curriculum and a success-gated diversity objective to discover diverse solutions while preserving task success. The trained generator produces multiple successful closed-loop behaviors, which are safety-filtered and exported as a static dataset for downstream imitation learning. Across four manipulation tasks, DiscoDemo produces broader successful-state coverage and improves downstream visuomotor policies in both simulation and the real world. Averaged across tasks, downstream success increases to 62% from 40% for the strongest baseline in simulation, and to 78% from 39% on the real robot, respectively. These results suggest that successful solution diversity improves imitation learning for a pretrained flow-matching VLA and remains complementary to corrective data collection. Project page: https://davian-robotics.github.io/DiscoDemo
hf.titleZh: DiscoDemo:为模仿学习挖掘高效且多样的机器人演示数据
hf.summaryZh: 机器人操作的行为克隆对训练数据覆盖度高度敏感，而采集多样化的成功演示成本高昂。DiscoDemo把强化学习当作数据生成器而非部署控制器:训练带特权信息的潜变量条件RL生成器，配合并行反向课程与成功门控的多样性目标，在保持任务成功的前提下发现多种解法，再将多组成功闭环行为经安全过滤导出为静态数据集，供下游视觉运动模仿学习使用。在四个操作任务上，成功状态的覆盖范围更广，下游策略成功率在仿真中由最强基线的40%提升到62%，在真实机器人上由39%提升到78%，并且与纠错式数据采集形成互补。
hf.reason: 机器人操作与VLA数据生成，属画像低分方向

hf.title: TenetBench: A Clause-Anchored Russian Corpus for Evaluating Language Models against Professional Codes of Ethics
hf.abstract: Codes of professional ethics guide and restrict specialists, who increasingly work with assistants built on large language models. Such an assistant can breach the user's code, or help the user breach it, without the user noticing. Evaluations reporting broad categories of harm cannot show how often this happens or which provision is breached. TenetBench pairs 3,433 requests conflicting with clauses of fifteen Russian-language professional codes with benign twins that differ only in the legitimacy of what is asked. An automated pipeline generates the tasks from the text of a code, so the corpus grows with every code added and a provision yields new tasks on every run. It also produced tasks and human-validated verdicts from two English codes of other jurisdictions. In human validation of the frozen pipeline, specialists rated 0.995 of the conflicting tasks plausible, and the model judge agreed with the adjudicated label at Gwet's AC1 of at least 0.894 on 1,860 elements. We evaluated fourteen model and reasoning-mode combinations on whether they produce the conflicting text, decline or warn. Eleven of the fourteen produce conflicting content on most such requests, mostly without a warning, and nearly three warnings in four accompany conflicting content. The models that conform more do so by declining while still serving the legitimate twin, and enabling reasoning halved the refusals of two models. We hope the dataset and pipeline will help evaluate how language models observe professional norms and let diagnostic datasets be built for particular professions and organisations.
hf.titleZh: TenetBench：一个以条款为锚的俄语语料库，用于依据职业伦理准则评估语言模型
hf.summaryZh: 现有危害评估只报告宽泛类别，无法判断模型具体违反了哪一条职业伦理条款、违反频率多高。TenetBench 将 3,433 条与十五部俄语职业伦理准则条款相冲突的请求，与仅在合法性上不同的良性孪生请求配对；同时提供一条自动化流水线，它从准则原文生成任务，每新增一部准则即可扩充语料，并已用另外两部其他司法辖区的英语准则生成任务，再由人工校验裁定。人工验证中，专家判定 0.995 的冲突任务可信，模型评判与裁定标签在 1,860 个元素上的 Gwet's AC1 不低于 0.894。评测十四个模型与推理模式组合发现：其中十一个对多数冲突请求直接产出违规内容且多无警告，近四分之三的警告仍伴随违规内容；合规性更强的模型选择拒答但仍服务良性孪生，开启推理使两个模型的拒答率减半。
hf.reason: 伦理准则基准设计扎实，但领域偏窄、语种受限

hf.title: DraMaze: A Multi-Agent Pipeline with Future-Aware Memory for Diverse Microdrama Script Generation
hf.abstract: The rapid growth of microdramas has increased demand for high-quality script production. Long-form microdrama script generation with LLMs requires both diverse plot progression and long-range narrative coherence. Our observations reveal that candidate continuations increasingly concentrate on fewer narrative mechanisms as generation progresses, while conventional retrieval may reinforce trope reuse and overlook historical information essential to future plots. To address these challenges, we propose DraMaze, a multi-agent pipeline that explores diverse causal paths through trope memory-guided evolutionary tree search and mutation. It further constructs a Backward Narrative Dependency Tree to organize, retain, and retrieve historical memories based on future narrative goals. We also introduce MiDramaBench, a bilingual benchmark for evaluating script logic and creative quality across different script lengths, together with causal-pattern metrics for narrative repetition and diversity. Experiments show consistent improvements across three backbone LLMs. For 60-episode scripts of up to 60k words, DraMaze reduces causal-pattern repetition by 32.1% and achieves a Logic score of 82.5, outperforming the best-performing baseline by 8.5 points.
hf.titleZh: DraMaze:一条带未来感知记忆的多智能体流水线，用于多样化微短剧剧本生成
hf.summaryZh: 长篇微短剧剧本生成中，随剧情推进候选续写会越来越集中在少数叙事机制上，而常规检索式记忆又容易强化套路复用、漏掉对后续情节至关重要的历史信息。DraMaze 以套路记忆引导的进化树搜索与变异探索多样因果路径，并构建反向叙事依赖树，按未来叙事目标组织、保留与检索历史记忆;同时提出双语基准 MiDramaBench 及因果模式指标，衡量跨长度的剧本逻辑与创意质量。在三个基座 LLM 上均取得一致提升:60 集、最长 6 万词剧本的因果模式重复率下降 32.1%,Logic 得分 82.5，超过最佳基线 8.5 分。
hf.reason: 多智能体与未来感知记忆设计有新意，但属剧本创作垂直应用

hf.title: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders
hf.abstract: AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings---peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation---where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We present a pipeline that converts a fine-tuned neural detector into a classifier that operates on human-readable concepts. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector's residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features. We find that our SAEs recover latent concepts that correspond to highly specific and predictive linguistic "tells" of AI-generated text. Classifiers built on these extracted features are not only highly interpretable but exhibit stronger performance on out-of-distribution texts than either neural or stylometric alternatives.
hf.titleZh: 用稀疏自编码器构建可审计的 AI 文本检测器
hf.summaryZh: 解决的问题是:强 AI 文本检测器多为不透明的微调神经分类器，而可解释的风格计量分类器性能明显落后。方法是在检测器的残差流上直接训练稀疏自编码器(SAE)，为每个特征自动生成解释标签，只保留描述通过全局保真度阈值的特征，再仅用这些可解释特征训练轻量分类器。结果显示 SAE 恢复出的潜在概念对应高度具体、预测性强的语言「破绽」，所得分类器不仅可解释，在分布外文本上的表现也优于神经检测器与风格计量方法。适用于同行评审、教育、招生等需要可审计依据的检测场景。
hf.reason: SAE 可解释性用于文本检测，方向擦边，分量中等

hf.title: FLOMSS: Generative Music Source Separation by Flow Matching
hf.abstract: Music source separation (MSS) has been conventionally addressed by discriminative methods. Recently, flow matching has emerged as a strong generative paradigm for modeling complex data distributions, with successful applications across diverse domains. These advances motivate us to systematically investigate flow matching for MSS in a four-source (Vocals, Bass, Drums, Other) setting in full-band stereo. Specifically, we investigate prediction targets, flow paths, single-source versus multi-source modeling, and mixture consistency constraints. Beyond the signal-level metrics commonly used for MSS, such as signal-to-distortion ratio, we further evaluate MSS methods using embedding-based metrics, as well as a listening test, providing a comprehensive benchmark. On MUSDB18-HQ, our proposed model exhibits competitive performance in both objective and subjective tests, highlighting the potential of flow matching for generative MSS. Demo: https://ik4sumii.github.io/FLOMSS/
hf.titleZh: FLOMSS:基于流匹配的生成式音乐源分离
hf.summaryZh: 面向音乐源分离长期由判别式方法主导的现状，系统考察流匹配在四轨(人声、贝斯、鼓、其他)全频带立体声设定下的生成式建模。围绕预测目标、流路径、单源与多源建模、混合一致性约束四个设计维度展开对比;除SDR等信号级指标外，还引入基于嵌入的指标与听音测试构建综合基准。在MUSDB18-HQ上客观与主观测试均取得有竞争力的表现，显示流匹配用于生成式音乐源分离的潜力。
hf.reason: 音乐源分离属音频生成应用，不在关注方向内

hf.title: MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
hf.abstract: In a hierarchical multi-agent system, a Leader assigns tasks and subagents carry them out. Jointly training the Leader and the subagents is difficult because a final answer gives only indirect feedback to the subagents. An LLM judge can score the performance of the subagents, but these scores depend on the judge's own assessment of the quality of subagents' responses. We present MultiAgent-OPD, which combines on-policy distillation with reinforcement learning to jointly train a shared-parameter Leader-Searcher-Answerer team end to end. We first train a Teacher in a Searcher-Answerer workflow using answer correctness. During team training, the frozen Teacher scores student-generated search and summary tokens to provide local process supervision for the Searchers, while the Leader learns from team success and the Answerer from candidate correctness. Across seven datasets, the trained system reaches 38.68% macro avg@4, exceeding Prompted Critic by 4.06 percentage points and C-MAS + RL, the trained cascaded multiagent system, by 2.61 percentage points. The team also solves more questions within four attempts.
hf.titleZh: MultiAgent-OPD:用同策略蒸馏端到端训练分层多智能体系统
hf.summaryZh: 分层多智能体系统中，最终答案对子智能体只能提供间接反馈，联合训练 Leader 与子智能体因此困难;用 LLM judge 打分子智能体又受 judge 自身判断质量影响。MultiAgent-OPD 将同策略蒸馏与强化学习结合，对共享参数的 Leader-Searcher-Answerer 团队做端到端训练:先在 Searcher-Answerer 流程中用答案正确性训练教师，团队训练时由冻结教师对学生生成的搜索与摘要 token 打分，为 Searcher 提供局部过程监督，Leader 依据团队成功信号学习，Answerer 依据候选答案正确性学习。在七个数据集上 macro avg@4 达 38.68%，分别超过 Prompted Critic 与经过 RL 训练的级联多智能体系统 C-MAS + RL 4.06 与 2.61 个百分点，且在四次尝试内解出更多问题。
hf.reason: 多智能体端到端后训练结合同策略蒸馏，直接命中 Agentic RL 方向

hf.title: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
hf.abstract: Single-image 3D scene construction is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Recent methods such as SAM-3Dfy enable end-to-end reconstruction of 3D assets and their scene layouts, but still struggle with fine-grained scene geometry and asset quality. Meanwhile, specialized 3D object generators provide detailed object geometry, while 3D foundation models offer strong and generalizable spatial understanding. We propose Easy-3Dfy, a compositional workflow that decouples object generation from scene layout estimation, allowing specialized models to fully exploit their respective strengths. An RPF-based aligner then bridges these capabilities by establishing geometric correspondence between object-local meshes and partial scene pointmaps, recovering object layout for scene composition. Without requiring complete scene-level supervision, the proposed workflow consistently outperforms SAM-3Dfy across multiple geometric metrics on Scene-Maker and 3D-FUTURE200. Our results demonstrate that explicit geometric composition can effectively combine high-quality object generation with strong spatial understanding, while enabling the workflow to benefit independently from advances in both 3D object generation and foundation models.
hf.titleZh: Easy-3Dfy:面向单图像3D场景构建的对象级几何组合
hf.summaryZh: 针对单图像3D场景构建中端到端方法(如SAM-3Dfy)细粒度几何与资产质量不足的问题，提出将物体生成与场景布局估计解耦的组合式流程，让专用3D物体生成器与3D基础模型各自发挥优势。核心是用基于RPF的对齐器在物体局部网格与部分场景pointmap之间建立几何对应，从而恢复物体布局并完成场景组合。该方法无需完整的场景级监督，在Scene-Maker与3D-FUTURE200上多项几何指标稳定优于SAM-3Dfy，说明显式几何组合能同时受益于物体生成与空间理解两方面的进展。
hf.reason: 单图像3D场景重建，属视觉重建低分方向

hf.title: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
hf.abstract: Language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content, user history, and feedback. However, evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. We introduce DuoLM, a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. An encoder LLM learns compact item representations for offline reuse, while a personalized ranker LLM combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. We train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. The runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token IDs for embedding access, shared history computation, and CUDA Graph replay. Benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. On a single H100, it delivers approximately 26,400 candidate scores per second, about 60times the throughput of the teacher served with vLLM and automatic prefix caching.
hf.titleZh: DuoLM：用语言模型实现快速而有效的个性化推荐
hf.summaryZh: 针对用完整文本输入对大量候选物品打分时在线算力开销大、服务吞吐受限的问题，提出将紧凑推荐模型与高效服务运行时结合的框架。编码器 LLM 离线学习可复用的紧凑物品表示，个性化排序 LLM 将其与用户历史、反馈结合完成推荐，两个模型以推荐监督信号加教师蒸馏端到端训练。运行时用虚拟 token ID 直接取嵌入、共享历史计算与 CUDA Graph 重放进一步加速；在单张 H100 上每秒约 26,400 个候选打分，是 vLLM 加自动前缀缓存的教师模型吞吐的约 60 倍，且推荐质量与教师模型相当。
hf.reason: LLM 推荐系统属垂直应用落地，但蒸馏加推理运行时优化有工程参考价值

hf.title: Generalized CycleGRPO for Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding and Grounding
hf.abstract: Fine-grained multimodal intelligence requires models to both understand a designated region and localize it from language. Existing methods learn these directions with separate objectives and task-specific annotations. We present Generalized CycleGRPO, the first unified reinforcement learning framework coupling region understanding and localization across spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal domains. Given a region, a multimodal large language model generates candidate descriptions and then localizes each description to reconstruct the input region. Reconstruction overlap provides a verifiable reward for captioning, while individual localization rewards improve the inverse mapping. A common region-space formulation extends this cycle from image masks and boxes to video intervals and timestamped spatial evidence, without reference captions or an external language-model judge during reinforcement learning. In videos, the cycle encourages descriptions that distinguish a target event from similar recurrences. We introduce DOVE (Distinctive Occurrence-level Video-caption Evaluation), a human-verified contrastive benchmark for this temporal distinctiveness. CycleGRPO improves SAMTok's overall gIoU from 57.5% to 68.2% on GroundingSuite and average gIoU from 71.2% to 78.7% on GRES. For temporal tasks, it achieves 51.9% tIoU on Charades and 33.3% Temporal Evidence Coverage on DOVE, compared with 45.6% and 14.8% for the Qwen3-VL initialization. These results establish region-text cycle consistency as a general self-evaluation principle for multimodal understanding and localization. Models, code, and DOVE are available at https://devinxzhang.github.io/Generalized-CycleGRPO-Page/.
hf.titleZh: Generalized CycleGRPO：面向细粒度多模态理解与定位的通用框架
hf.summaryZh: 针对多模态模型「理解指定区域」与「由语言定位区域」两个方向各自独立训练、依赖任务专属标注的问题，提出统一强化学习框架Generalized CycleGRPO：模型先对给定区域生成候选描述，再将每条描述重新定位以重建原区域，用重建重叠度作为描述的可验证奖励，同时用单条定位奖励改进反向映射，无需参考描述或外部LLM裁判。该框架把图像掩码与框、视频区间及带时间戳的空间证据统一到同一「区域空间」表述中，在视频上还能促使描述区分目标事件与相似重现。实验中GroundingSuite总体gIoU由57.5%升至68.2%，GRES平均gIoU由71.2%升至78.7%，Charades tIoU达51.9%（初始化45.6%），并发布DOVE对比基准，Temporal Evidence Coverage为33.3%（初始化14.8%）。
hf.reason: 多模态grounding的RLVR闭环，方法新、实验扎实

hf.title: HoloBoxing: A Simple Recipe for Humanoid Boxing with 7 Minutes of Single-GPU Training
hf.abstract: HoloBoxing presents a simple recipe for learning humanoid boxing by building on a pretrained whole-body controller. The recipe separates reusable motor skills from task decisions: a compact planner requests future body-point targets, while the frozen controller handles joint-level execution. A learned decoder maps 32-dimensional actions to structured target windows, and measured-state imitation initializes the planner before reinforcement learning. Task learning then refines interaction behavior while reusing the decoder and controller, avoiding the need to relearn whole-body control. This combination keeps task optimization focused on a compact upper policy and supplies an initial behavior before reward-driven exploration. Starting from that available controller, the recipe accounts for about seven minutes of additional training, including reused representation fitting and a single-GPU task run. This excludes controller pretraining, data preparation, evaluation, and search. Simulated boxing experiments and component controls evaluate the resulting behavior and the roles of imitation initialization and the target representation.
hf.titleZh: HoloBoxing：7 分钟单 GPU 训练的人形拳击简单方案
hf.summaryZh: 面向人形机器人拳击任务，把可复用的运动技能与任务决策拆开：预训练并冻结的全身控制器负责关节级执行，紧凑 planner 输出未来身体点目标；学习到的解码器将 32 维动作映射为结构化目标窗口，并先用实测状态模仿初始化 planner，再用强化学习精化交互行为。任务优化因此只集中在紧凑的上层策略上，无需重学全身控制。在已有控制器基础上，包含表征拟合与单卡任务运行的额外训练约 7 分钟，不含控制器预训练、数据准备与评测。仿真拳击实验与组件对照验证了该流程的效果，以及模仿初始化与目标表征的作用。
hf.reason: 人形机器人拳击属具身智能，画像明列为低分方向

hf.title: Kolab: Benchmarking Human-Agent Collaboration in Long-Horizon Workflows
hf.abstract: When humans collaborate with AI agents on long-horizon tasks, what happens to the agents' contributions? For solving long-horizon tasks, humans place greater importance on ongoing interaction with AI agents (e.g., revising plans) than on an agent's ability to complete the task in a single attempt. However, most agentic benchmarks have focused more on automation. Strong performance on such benchmarks does not imply effective real-world collaboration. Professional workflows offer a useful setting, as they often involve interdependent steps. To address this gap, we introduce Kolab, a new dataset of 115+ hours of screen recordings of 50 professionals from 40 occupations collaborating with agents on realistic, long-horizon problems. Kolab also contains participants' collaboration and output quality judgments. Our analysis reveals diverse collaboration patterns, highlighting the importance of when and how professionals coordinate with agents. A collaborative agent must do two things that automation benchmarks never test: anticipate whether experts will adopt, modify, or reject its contribution once it leaves the chat window to guide its next steps, and assess collaboration quality from the unfolding workflow without constant expert feedback. Our benchmark operationalizes both: (1) forecasting how professionals use agent contributions at diverse workflows, and (2) verifying their judgments of collaboration satisfaction and output quality. Findings show that frontier models, both agentic and non-agentic, overestimate collaboration with experts and struggle to distinguish between high- and low-quality collaboration. Longer workflow context does not consistently improve these predictions. As frontier agents cannot yet understand long-horizon collaboration with experts, we position Kolab as a valuable dataset for studying human-agent collaboration grounded in real professional workflows.
hf.titleZh: Kolab：面向长时程工作流的人类-Agent 协作基准评测
hf.summaryZh: 现有 agentic 基准偏重单次自动化完成，难以反映真实长时程任务中人类与 Agent 的持续交互与修改。构建 Kolab：115+ 小时屏幕录像，覆盖 40 个职业的 50 位专业人士与 Agent 协作解决真实长时程问题，并记录其对协作过程与产出质量的判断。基准设置两项任务：预测专家会采纳、修改还是拒绝 Agent 的贡献，以及从展开的工作流中验证专家对协作满意度与产出质量的判断。前沿模型（含 agentic 模型）普遍高估专家协作程度，难以区分高低质量协作，更长的流程上下文也未带来稳定提升。
hf.reason: Agent 长时程协作基准，基于真实专业工作流，评测方向扎实

hf.title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
hf.abstract: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. Starting from the LaTeX source, PaperFormalizer transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement in natural language for faithfulness, ambiguity and correctness, and then formalizes and proves the statements in Lean against Mathlib, optional domain libraries and the author's personal toolkit. Only the author knows what a statement is meant to say and how a formalization gap in a result is best fixed. The pipeline therefore stops and asks the author whenever a statement admits more than one reading, presents every repair, in natural language and TeX symbols, as a proposal that the author can accept, decline or redirect, and leaves to the author every decision that could potentially change what the paper claims. The output is an annotated and revised version of the paper, a report of the changes, and Lean code in which each declaration is linked to the statement it formalizes. The author's toolkit grows as more papers are formalized, and authors can share their verified papers so that researchers who build on them can reuse their Lean code. By making verified papers practical to produce, PaperFormalizer aims to make research that rests on mathematical proofs more robust. PaperFormalizer runs inside a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) and is available at https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/PaperFormalizer. Papers with Lean code shared by users are available at https://paperformalizer.org.
hf.titleZh: PaperFormalizer:作者在环的论文 Lean 自动形式化
hf.summaryZh: 针对校对后的论文仍可能在证明与假设上留下缺口的问题，系统从 LaTeX 源码出发，把论文转写为陈述依赖图，用自然语言审计每条陈述的忠实性、歧义与正确性，再在 Mathlib 与作者自建工具库上完成 Lean 形式化与证明;当陈述存在多种解读时，流水线会停下询问作者，并把所有修复以提案形式交由作者接受、拒绝或改向。产出包括带注释的修订稿、改动报告以及与陈述一一对应的 Lean 代码，作者工具库随形式化论文增多而累积。系统以 Claude Code 或 Codex 内的编码智能体形式运行。
hf.reason: 科研智能体加 Lean 形式化流水线，方向契合但缺少量化结果

hf.title: MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
hf.abstract: Open multimodal reasoning models have benefited from large-scale reasoning supervision, yet reliable post-training remains challenging due to uneven data quality, inefficient supervision construction, imbalanced difficulty, and cross-domain interference. We introduce MMVistaReason (MVR), an open-data post-training recipe with three components: (1) broader capability coverage across complementary Analytical and Real-World reasoning groups, emphasizing structured reasoning versus visual perception and spatial grounding; (2) efficient SFT and RL data construction, standardizing heterogeneous open data through staged cleaning and annotation, combining difficulty-aware cascaded teacher distillation with answer-likelihood-based trajectory selection to construct MVR-SFT-528K, and applying scale-specific frontier filtering for MVR-RL-63K; and (3) specialize-then-integrate training, which trains complementary RL experts and consolidates their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Our analyses reveal a capacity-dependent interaction between supervision difficulty, trajectory quality, and model capacity: smaller students benefit more from selected supervision, while larger students are robust to trajectory variation and mixed-domain interference. Mixed-domain RL introduces benchmark-level negative transfer, whereas MOPD provides consistent capability integration, with the preferred KL direction varying across model scales. Across 15 multimodal benchmarks, MVR-4B achieves an average score of 72.8, outperforming Qwen3.5-9B (Instruct) and MMFineReason-8B while using about 70% fewer samples than MMFineReason. Scaling to 9B improves the average to 74.4, surpassing Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Instruct). Overall, MMVistaReason demonstrates that systematic open-data construction and capacity-aware post-training provide a practical and scalable path toward reliable multimodal reasoning.
hf.titleZh: MMVistaReason：面向多模态推理的开放数据与后训练方案
hf.summaryZh: 针对开放多模态推理模型后训练中的数据质量参差、难度失衡与跨域干扰，提出开放数据方案MMVistaReason：按分析推理与真实场景分组覆盖能力，经分阶段清洗、难度感知级联教师蒸馏与答案似然轨迹筛选构建MVR-SFT-528K，以前沿过滤得到MVR-RL-63K，再用分域RL专家加多教师同策略蒸馏（MOPD）整合能力。分析表明监督难度与模型容量存在依赖关系，混合域RL会造成负迁移，MOPD可稳定整合。MVR-4B在15个多模态基准上平均72.8分，超过Qwen3.5-9B（Instruct）与MMFineReason-8B，样本少约70%；9B版本达74.4分，超过Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（Instruct）。
hf.reason: 多模态推理的开放数据后训练方案，含RL与多教师蒸馏，扎实

hf.title: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
hf.abstract: Recognizing task completion and failure enables robots to stop upon success and initiate recovery or replanning after failure. Existing methods augment Vision Language Action (VLA) policies with task status signal prediction to support these execution decisions. However, learning and integrating these signals can require fine-grained supervision, external monitoring models, or complex architectural designs. Moreover, the potential of task status signals to directly guide action generation remains underexplored. We present Echo, a framework that combines task status signal learning without frame-level progress annotations with a compact design for status prediction and action generation within a single VLA. Specifically, Echo represents task status with stop and failure signals, added as two dimensions of each action chunk and denoised together with robot actions. Their combination distinguishes ongoing execution, successful completion, and failure. To learn these signals without fine-grained progress annotations, Echo constructs successful, failed, and recovery trajectories with complementary supervision properties. To enable status signal-guided action generation, Echo controls interactions between the signals and actions and denoises the signals faster than the actions. These allow later action denoising steps to condition on cleaner status estimates while preserving accurate signal prediction. Extensive real-world manipulation experiments show that Echo accurately predicts task status and consistently improves policy performance.
hf.titleZh: Echo:面向视觉-语言-动作模型的耦合动作与任务状态信号去噪
hf.summaryZh: 现有 VLA 策略若要判断任务完成与失败，需依赖细粒度进度标注、外部监控模型或复杂架构。Echo 把停止与失败两个状态信号作为动作块的两个附加维度，与机器人动作一并做扩散去噪，并用成功、失败与恢复轨迹构建互补监督，从而无需帧级进度标注;同时通过控制信号与动作的交互、让状态信号比动作去噪得更快，使后续动作去噪步能条件于更干净的状态估计。真实机器人操作实验显示其状态预测准确，并稳定提升策略性能。
hf.reason: VLA 与机器人操作属画像明确的低分方向，即便结合 LLM 组件

hf.title: JockeyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Horse-Racing Decision-Making
hf.abstract: Repeated event forecasting requires extracting predictive signals from noisy evidence and evaluating their value across successive decisions. We introduce JockeyBench, a benchmark and evaluation protocol that studies this problem through historical Japanese horse racing. The protocol combines time-gated evidence, priced tools, paired frozen-program controls, and two workflows: executing an LLM-written predictor or acquiring evidence for a fresh per-race LLM forecast. Evaluation separates forecast quality, benchmark-specific net utility, and retrospective betting returns and risk under fixed decision rules. Across 28 model--scaffold configurations on 324 races, paired tests identify seven revision gains and two declines after multiple-testing correction. Yet every configuration has negative mean profit under capped-Kelly settlement. In a four-model comparison, the reusable-program workflow has higher mean betting profit and lower research fees, although both workflows lose on average. Further diagnostics reveal that mean probability bias reverses on selected bets and that profitable individual runs can depend on concentrated returns. These findings motivate evaluating predictive competence, adaptation, resource use, and decision value separately when assessing agents for repeated event forecasting.
hf.titleZh: JockeyBench:在赛马决策上评测 LLM Agent
hf.summaryZh: 以日本赛马历史数据为试验台，构建面向重复事件预测的 JockeyBench 基准与评测协议:采用时间门控证据、计费工具、成对冻结程序对照，并设两条工作流——执行 LLM 编写的预测程序，或逐场重新取证后做单场预测。评测将预测质量、基准内净效用与固定决策规则下的投注收益、风险分开度量。在 324 场比赛、28 种模型-脚手架组合上，多重检验校正后仅得到 7 项改进与 2 项退化，且所有配置在封顶 Kelly 结算下平均利润为负;四模型对比中可复用程序工作流的平均投注利润更高、研究开销更低。结果表明评估此类 Agent 需分开衡量预测能力、适应性、资源消耗与决策价值。
hf.reason: Agent 评测协议设计较扎实，但赛马投注属垂直应用，方向擦边

hf.title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
hf.abstract: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.
hf.titleZh: 投机扩散的两种权衡
hf.summaryZh: 考察扩散 LLM 用作投机解码草稿模型时的速度-质量权衡:传统投机解码相对验证器分布无损，而扩散 LLM 可以通过减少扩散步数，以降质换速度;投机解码本身也可以放宽接受准则而变得有损。把「扩散努力」与「接受宽松度」作为两个可调参数联合扫描，刻画完整可达的 Pareto 前沿。实验显示，联合调节这两个参数可以把速度-质量前沿扩展到单步扩散草稿之外，为低延迟推理中的草稿-验证配置提供更宽的选点空间。
hf.reason: 投机解码与推理加速沾边，但扩散语言模型按画像归低分

hf.title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
hf.abstract: Video generation models are promising foundations for embodied world models, but only if their generated rollouts are physically valid and faithful to task instructions. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to judge these properties, yet their agreement with human judgments on embodied videos has not been systematically evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboJudge-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs as judges of embodied video generation. The benchmark measures two fundamental dimensions, Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment, across 800 human-annotated videos from 8 source corpora and 10 video generators, spanning grippers, human hands, and dexterous hands. Experiments reveal uneven alignment between existing judges and human ratings: general-purpose MLLMs show lower agreement on physical adherence, while specialized video judges designed for general-domain physical reasoning do not consistently transfer to embodied scenarios. Motivated by these findings, we construct RoboJudge-Train, comprising 12K videos annotated with 25K human-verified scores and model-assisted rationales for Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment. We fine-tune a 9B MLLM on this dataset with supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning, yielding RoboJudge-9B. Among the model judges evaluated on RoboJudge-Bench, RoboJudge-9B achieves the highest overall agreement, reaching a Pearson correlation of 0.719 with a statistically significant 0.089 gain over Gemini-3.7-Flash, the best-performing proprietary baseline in our evaluation. Training on RoboJudge-Train also yields gains on external benchmarks, including VideoPhy2 and Physion-Eval. We further use RoboJudge-9B as a downstream evaluator to benchmark video generation models according to Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment.
hf.titleZh: RoboJudge:以多模态语言模型作为具身视频生成的评判者
hf.summaryZh: 针对多模态大模型评判具身视频生成时与人类判断的一致性缺乏系统评估的问题，构建RoboJudge-Bench:覆盖8个来源语料、10个视频生成器的800条人工标注视频，从物理合理性与指令对齐两个维度评分。实验显示通用MLLM在物理合理性上一致性偏低，面向通用域物理推理的专用视频评判模型也难以迁移到具身场景。据此构建含12K视频、25K人工核验分数的RoboJudge-Train，用监督学习加强化学习微调9B MLLM得到RoboJudge-9B，与人类评分的Pearson相关达0.719，较最佳闭源基线Gemini-3.7-Flash显著提升0.089，并在VideoPhy2、Physion-Eval上同步获益。
hf.reason: MLLM评判模型的SFT+RL训练方法扎实，但绑定具身视频生成场景

hf.title: DISC: Domain-Integrated Similarity Cost for Time-Series Dataset
hf.abstract: The growth of time-series datasets and foundation models has made dataset comparison a central part of time-series workflows. Assessing source-target transfer before model adaptation requires similarity estimates that can summarize transfer-related dataset relationships without exhaustive source-target evaluation over every candidate pair. Many metrics have been proposed for measuring similarity between time-series datasets, but they capture different dataset relationships and vary in how well they align with downstream utility across tasks. We evaluate this gap by measuring the correlation between source-target similarity scores and downstream forecasting errors in out-of-distribution and transfer-learning settings. We propose Domain-Integrated Similarity Cost (DISC), a learnable aggregation framework that uses calibration transfer observations to select, weight, and combine similarity metrics for different downstream tasks. By integrating complementary metric values, DISC better distinguishes source-target dataset differences that matter for downstream behavior. After calibration, DISC scores source-target pairs using only their similarity-metric values and yields higher alignment than single-metric references on the reported split. These results show that time-series dataset similarity is task-dependent, and that learned metric integration provides a stronger proxy for downstream transfer behavior than manually selecting one similarity metric.
hf.titleZh: DISC:面向时间序列数据集的领域整合相似度代价
hf.summaryZh: 时间序列数据集与基础模型规模增长后，需要在不对每个候选源-目标对做穷举评估的前提下估计迁移可行性，而现有多种数据集相似度指标刻画的关系各异，与下游效用的对齐程度不一。DISC 通过校准阶段的迁移观测学习指标的选取、加权与组合，把互补的相似度值整合成任务相关的打分，校准后仅凭相似度指标值即可评估源-目标对。在分布外与迁移学习设置上，该方法与下游预测误差的相关性优于任一单指标基线。结果表明时间序列数据集相似性是任务相关的，学习式指标整合比人工挑选单一指标更能代理迁移后的实际表现。
hf.reason: 时间序列数据集相似度选择，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线无关

hf.title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
hf.abstract: Location encoders map geographic coordinates to high-dimensional descriptors through contrastive alignment with paired Earth Observation imagery. We prove that this construction is structurally limited: any Lipschitz location encoder produces an output of intrinsic dimension at most 2, regardless of architecture or bandwidth, which forces the contrastive loss to strictly exceed its asymptotic optimum. Empirically, joint training also collapses the encoder's embedding covariance to low rank. Although dimension-limited, current location encoders sidestep this spectral collapse by training against a frozen image encoder, which we reinterpret as a covariance regularizer that supplies a high-rank target for the location encoder to fold onto. However, extending this approach to multimodal inputs is challenging, as location encoders should simultaneously map a single location to multiple, potentially incompatible, descriptors. We identify two requirements a regularizer must satisfy for location encoding in multimodal regimes: co-alignment across modalities, since adapters alone cannot align independently pretrained encoders; and high effective rank, since the location encoder inherits its target's spectrum. We propose LoCA (Location Contrastive Alignment), a two-stage pipeline that satisfies both. Stage 1 jointly trains Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 encoders with contrastive learning, producing a co-aligned, high-rank multimodal target. Stage 2 freezes the image encoders and trains a location and a tabular metadata encoder as projection adapters with multi-view contrastive learning. Against five state-of-the-art encoders on 17 tasks ranging from land cover and wildfire forecasting to geophysical, socio-economic, biodiversity and climate applications, LoCA achieves the most task wins, is the only model to outperform every other on a majority of tasks, and wins 68.8% of all per-task comparisons.
hf.titleZh: LoCA：在地理空间位置编码器中实现多模态
hf.summaryZh: 位置编码器通过与遥感影像对比对齐，把地理坐标映射为高维描述子；该工作证明，任何 Lipschitz 位置编码器的输出本征维数至多为 2，导致对比损失严格高于渐近最优，并使嵌入协方差坍缩为低秩，而现有多模态方案还面临跨模态共对齐与高有效秩两项要求。LoCA 采用两阶段流程：先用对比学习联合训练 Sentinel-1 与 Sentinel-2 影像编码器，得到共对齐、高秩的多模态目标；再冻结影像编码器，以多视图对比学习训练位置编码器与表格元数据编码器，使其充当投影适配器。在 17 项覆盖土地覆盖、野火预测、地球物理、社会经济、生物多样性与气候的任务上，LoCA 相对五个 SOTA 编码器取得最多任务胜出，是唯一在多数任务上超过所有对比者的模型，逐任务比较胜率 68.8%。该工作为遥感与地理空间多模态表征的构建提供了理论刻画与可复用方案，适用于地球观测基础模型的位置编码与下游迁移。
hf.reason: 地理空间位置编码与遥感多模态，与 LLM 主线关联弱
